models.name: dinov2_pet
models.source: tools/dinov2_pet_export.py — fp32 ONNX export of AvitoTech/DINO-v2-small-for-animal-identification (Hugging Face), CLS-token re-ID head
models.license: See the AvitoTech/DINO-v2-small-for-animal-identification model card; DINOv2 upstream is Apache-2.0
models.reason: Unlike the OpenCV Zoo YOLOX detector and the InsightFace buffalo_l pack, this ONNX has no upstream download URL — it is produced by a dev-only tool that needs torch + transformers. A packaged build must therefore carry it, or Pets identity grouping is unavailable to installed users.
